mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(biz04_provide_setup_id, rownum) AS provide_setup_id, #{companyId} AS company_id, sys09_code AS provide_content_code, sys09_name AS provide_content_name, COALESCE(biz04_emp_set_yn,'false') AS emp_set_yn FROM ( SELECT row_number() over(order by sys09_code) AS rownum , * FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id LEFT OUTER JOIN biz04_provide_setup ON ( biz04_provide_content_cd = sys09_code AND biz04_company_id = #{companyId} ) WHERE sys09_company_id = CASE WHEN COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE #{companyId} END AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') != 'true' AND f_today() BETWEEN sys09_apply_date AND COALESCE(sys09_close_date,'9999-12-31') AND sys08_kind_cd = 'ProvideContentCode' AND sys09_code LIKE #{providePurCode} ) t
